title: Play-Nice Site Well-Known File
description: The /.well-known/play-nice.json file a site publishes when it claims Play-Nice (contracts/sites/FRIENDLY_SITE.md, rules 4-6). Shape follows security.txt (RFC 9116): a contact and a self-expiring claim, so a site's statement goes stale on its own instead of quietly rotting.

version.description: Play-Nice library version the claim is made against. Semantic version, e.g. 2.0.0.

packs.description: Directory names of the Play-Nice packs the site follows (e.g. "sites"). Honest listing only: a pack here means the site meets that pack's rules.

contact.description: How to reach a human about this claim, like security.txt (RFC 9116). mailto:, https:/http: URI, or tel:.

expires.description: UTC date after which the claim must not be trusted. Consumers treat a passed date as stale, never as current.

agent_card.description: Optional. Present when the site is an agent: URL of its A2A agent card, conventionally https://<host>/.well-known/agent-card.json.

$comment: Served as application/json at exactly /.well-known/play-nice.json (RFC 8615). No secrets here: everything in this file is public by design.
